questions.question: How many connections does the atom 19 have?
questions.evidence: connections refers to fld004; atom 19 refers to fld001 like 'TR%_19';
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T.fld004) FROM tab03 AS T WHERE SUBSTRING(T.fld001, -2) = '19'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T.bond_id) FROM connected AS T WHERE SUBSTR(T.atom_id, -2) = '19'

questions.question: Find the triple-bonded molecules which are carcinogenic.
questions.evidence: triple-bonded molecules refers to fld005 = '#'; carcinogenic refers to fld007 = '+'
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.fld002 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE T1.fld005 = '#' AND T2.fld007 = '+'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#' AND T2.label = '+'

questions.question: What are the elements of the toxicology and label of molecule TR060?
questions.evidence: TR060 is the molecule id;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld003, T2.fld007 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE T2.fld002 = 'TR060'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element, T2.label FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR060'

questions.question: What is the percentage of carbon in double-bond molecules?
questions.evidence: carbon refers to fld003 = 'c'; double-bond molecules refers to fld005 = '='; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(fld003 = 'c'), COUNT(fld001))
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.fld003 = 'c' THEN T1.fld001 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE T2.fld005 = '='
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '='

questions.question: What elements are in the TR004_8_9 bond atoms?
questions.evidence: TR004_8_9 bond atoms refers to fld004 = 'TR004_8_9';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld003 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld004 = 'TR004_8_9'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

questions.question: How many bonds which involved atom 12 does molecule TR009 have?
questions.evidence: TR009 is the molecule id;  involved atom 12 refers to fld001 = 'TR009_12' or fld006 = 'TR009_12'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T2.fld004) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld004 = T2.fld004 WHERE T1.fld002 = 'TR009' AND T2.fld001 = T1.fld002 || '_1' OR T2.fld006 = T1.fld002 || '_2'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T2.bond_id) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR009' AND T2.atom_id = T1.molecule_id || '_1' OR T2.atom_id2 = T1.molecule_id || '_2'

questions.question: Tally the toxicology element of the 4th atom of each molecule that was carcinogenic.
questions.evidence: fld007 = '+' means molecules are carcinogenic; 4th atom of each molecule refers to substr(fld001, 7, 1) = '4';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld003 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE T2.fld007 = '+' AND SUBSTRING(T1.fld001, -1) = '4' AND LENGTH(T1.fld001) = 7
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+' AND SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, -1) = '4' AND LENGTH(T1.atom_id) = 7

questions.question: Is the molecule with the most double bonds carcinogenic?
questions.evidence: double bond refers to fld005 = ' = '; fld007 = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld007 FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT T.fld002, COUNT(T.fld005) FROM tab02 AS T WHERE T.fld005 = '=' GROUP BY T.fld002 ORDER BY COUNT(T.fld005) DESC LIMIT 1) AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.label FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT T.molecule_id, COUNT(T.bond_type) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY T.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T.bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

questions.question: Which non-carcinogenic molecules consisted more than 5 atoms?
questions.evidence: fld007 = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic; molecules consisted more than 5 atoms refers to COUNT(fld002) > 5
questions.SQL: SELECT T.fld002 FROM (SELECT T1.fld002, COUNT(T2.fld001) FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE T1.fld007 = '-' GROUP BY T1.fld002 HAVING COUNT(T2.fld001) > 5) AS t
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T.molecule_id FROM ( SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T2.atom_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '-' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) > 5 ) t

questions.question: What elements are in a double type bond?
questions.evidence: double type bond refers to fld005 = '=';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld003 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T3 ON T1.fld001 = T3.fld001 WHERE T2.fld005 = '='
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '='

questions.question: Which bond type accounted for the majority of the bonds found in molecule TR010 and state whether or not this molecule is carcinogenic?
questions.evidence: TR010 is the molecule id; majority of the bond found refers to MAX(COUNT(fld005));
questions.SQL: SELECT T.fld005 FROM (SELECT T1.fld005, COUNT(T1.fld002) FROM tab02 AS T1 WHERE T1.fld002 = 'TR010' GROUP BY T1.fld005 ORDER BY COUNT(T1.fld002) DESC LIMIT 1) AS T
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T.bond_type FROM ( SELECT T1.bond_type, COUNT(T1.molecule_id) FROM bond AS T1  WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY T1.bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(T1.molecule_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T

questions.question: On average how many carcinogenic molecules are single bonded?
questions.evidence: carcinogenic molecules refers to fld007 = '+'; single-bonded refers to fld005 = '-'; average = DIVIDE(SUM(fld005 = '-'), COUNT(fld001))
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT T3.fld002, COUNT(T1.fld005) AS single_bond_count FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T3 ON T3.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE T1.fld005 = '-' AND T3.fld007 = '+' GROUP BY T3.fld002) AS subquery
questions.SQL_original: SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT T3.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type) AS single_bond_count FROM bond AS T1  INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T3.label = '+' GROUP BY T3.molecule_id) AS subquery

questions.question: List all the elements of atoms that can not bond with any other atoms.
questions.evidence: atoms cannot bond with other atoms means fld001 NOT in connected table;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T.fld003 FROM tab01 AS T WHERE NOT T.fld003 IN (SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld003 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001)
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.element NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id )

questions.question: What is the percentage of double bonds in the molecule TR008? Please provide your answer as a percentage with five decimal places.
questions.evidence: double bond refers to fld005 = '='; TR008 is the molecule id; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(fld005 = '='), COUNT(fld004)) as percent where fld002 = 'TR008'
questions.SQL: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.fld005 = '=' THEN T.fld004 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.fld004), 5) FROM tab02 AS T WHERE T.fld002 = 'TR008'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.bond_type = '=' THEN T.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.bond_id),5) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR008'

questions.question: How much of the hydrogen in molecule TR206 is accounted for? Please provide your answer as a percentage with four decimal places.
questions.evidence: hydrogen refers to fld003 = 'h'; TR206 is the molecule id; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(fld003 = 'h'), COUNT(fld001)) as percent where fld002 = 'TR206'
questions.SQL: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.fld003 = 'h' THEN T.fld001 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.fld001), 4) FROM tab01 AS T WHERE T.fld002 = 'TR206'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.element = 'h' THEN T.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.atom_id),4) FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR206'

questions.question: Among all the atoms from 21 to 25, list all the molecules that are carcinogenic.
questions.evidence: atoms from 21 to 25 refers to SUBSTR(fld001, 7, 2) between '21' and '25'; fld007 = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.fld002 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE SUBSTRING(T1.fld001, -2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25' AND T2.fld007 = '+'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, -2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25' AND T2.label = '+'

questions.question: What are the atoms of the triple bond with the molecule "TR041"?
questions.evidence: TR041 is the molecule id; triple bond refers to fld005 = '#';
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld001, T2.fld006 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T3 ON T2.fld004 = T3.fld004 WHERE T3.fld005 = '#' AND T3.fld002 = 'TR041'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#' AND T3.molecule_id = 'TR041'

questions.question: Calculate the average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules.
questions.evidence: single-bonded molecules refers to fld005 = '-' ; average number of oxygen tab01 = AVG(fld003 = 'o')
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) FROM (SELECT T1.fld002, COUNT(T1.fld003) AS oxygen_count FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE T2.fld005 = '-' AND T1.fld003 = 'o' GROUP BY T1.fld002) AS oxygen_counts
questions.SQL_original: SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) FROM (SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.element) AS oxygen_count FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id  WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.element = 'o'  GROUP BY T1.molecule_id) AS oxygen_counts

questions.question: What is the composition of element chlorine in percentage among the single bond molecules?
questions.evidence: element chlorine refers to fld003 = 'cl'; single bond refers to fld005 = '-'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(fld003 = 'cl'), COUNT(fld001)) as percent where fld005 = '-'
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.fld003 = 'cl' THEN T.fld001 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.fld001) FROM (SELECT T1.fld001, T1.fld003 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T3 ON T2.fld002 = T3.fld002 WHERE T3.fld005 = '-') AS T
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.element = 'cl' THEN T.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.atom_id) FROM ( SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '-' ) AS T

questions.question: List the elements of all the triple bonds.
questions.evidence: triple bond refers to fld005 = '#';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T3.fld003 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld004 = T2.fld004 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T3 ON T2.fld001 = T3.fld001 WHERE T1.fld005 = '#'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T3.element FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#'
